item.title: Chaos and Dystopian news for the dead internet survivors
Jensen Huang says Nvidia is pulling back from OpenAI and Anthropic
item.description:
📝 It could be that simple. The investment Nvidia finalized just last week as part of OpenAI’s $110 billion round came in at $30 billion — well short of that earlier pledge. What’s looking more probable is that this is an exit from a situation that has gotten really complicated, really fast.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/04/jensen-huang-says-nvidia-is-pulling-back-from-openai-and-anthropic-but-his-explanation-raises-more-questions-than-it-answers/

item.title: US tech firms pledge at White House to bear costs of energy for datacenters
item.description:
📝 Trump speaks during a roundtable on the Ratepayer Protection Pledge with tech company leaders. Photograph: Bonnie Cash/EPAView image in fullscreenTrump speaks during a roundtable on the Ratepayer Protection Pledge with tech company leaders. “This means that the tech companies and the datacenters will be able to get the electricity they need, all without driving up electricity costs for consumers,” the president said at the pledge signing event.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/mar/04/us-tech-companies-energy-cost-pledge-white-house
